plain_english: In Śakti-egg-fragment middle, world-juices — all I drink always. Shown by skull-cup-blood-pretext — this as-it-were my within.
sanskrit_cite: śāktāṇḍakhaṇḍamadhye viśvarasāḥ sarvam ahaṃ pibāmi sadā vyañjayasi narakapālagarudhiramiṣād etad iva me 'ntaḥ

plain_english: Pride-heart-bond-uprooters — those two, these tufted embodied — as-it-were skull-lotuses — showing, held by You, Mahākāla.
sanskrit_cite: abhimānahṛdayabandhānutkhātau tāv imau saśikhau mūrtāv iva muṇdābjau prathayan dhatse mahākālaḥ

plain_english: All-world-seed-ground, first-station — imitated, treasure-of-waking. By palm-pomegranate-show-play, O god.
sanskrit_cite: akhilajagadbījabhuvaṃ prathamasthām anukaroṣi bodhanidhe karatalagabījapūrakadarśanalīlāyitād deva

plain_english: Bhairava-formed though — in hand rosary held — so by all-letter-expansion world turned within.
sanskrit_cite: bhairavarūpo 'py asi yat tatrāpi kare 'kṣamālikāṃ dhatse tat sarvākṣavikāsād viśvaṃ parivartayasy antaḥ

plain_english: Bone-handed-skull-garlanded-ash-decked, man-blood-hued — world by Brahma-fullness pure — thus the Lord teaches.
sanskrit_cite: asthikaramuṇḍamālābhasmābharaṇo nṛraktaruciḥ viśvaṃ brahmamayatvāc chuddham itīśaḥ samādiśasi

plain_english: For self-delight-full ones — adverse though sense-bubbles — what these desire-burning brow-eye showing supreme-fire-formed teach.
sanskrit_cite: svātmārāmamayānāṃ viṣamā api viṣayabudbudhāḥ kim amī smaradahanam alikanayanam prathayan paramāgnirūpam ādiśasi

plain_english: Inward-bound-aimed, expanding-facultied — though since always You are — that shown in all states, delusion-stain gone self.
sanskrit_cite: antarnibaddhalakṣyaḥ pravikāsikaraṇo 'pi yat sadā bhavasi tat prathayasi sarvadaśaṃ gatamohakalaṅkam ātmānam

plain_english: O god — sky-cladness Yours says uncovered of self form — suns-of-supreme-Brahma-fullness — Māyā-covering — how would-cover?
sanskrit_cite: deva digambaratā te vadati nirāvaraṇam ātmano rūpam paramabrahmamayārkān māyāvaraṇam kathaṃ vṛṇuyāt

plain_english: Destroyer of all, suns and the rest — I, darkness-ground — by spotless-autumn-sky-gleaming body — thus shown.
sanskrit_cite: saṃhartā sarveṣām arkādīnām ahaṃ tamobhūmiḥ nirmalaśāradagaganaprabheṇa vapuṣeti darśayasi

plain_english: Supreme-Brahma-full You, god — when taking Bhairava-form — that shown knower-of-principle — being though in difference freed — thus.
sanskrit_cite: paramabrahmamayas tvaṃ deva yadāśrayasi bhairavākāram tat prathayasi tattvajñaḥ saty api bhede vimukta iti
